item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: A network-automation operator conference. item.title: AutoCon 4 (Austin) — Operator
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: An operator-focused network automation program. Note up front: this cycle is heavy on automation practice, Day-2 operations, and the first wave of agentic-AI-in-production stories — lighter on the deep datapath/optics/identity material than a SIGCOMM or OSNA program, but the DC-fabric and WAN…

item.title: AutoCon 5 (Munich) — Operator Program
item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: AutoCon 5 is a network-automation operator conference, so nothing here touches optics, RDMA/lossless fabrics, eBPF/Cilium, or FIDO/SPIFFE directly. item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: Notes on this digest: of the 24 pre-selected items, 23 made the cut. item.title: IETF 122 (Bangkok)
item.description: Program source is the datatracker documents API, filtered to a curated set of 26 working groups touching cloud-native networking, network security, and identity. As with any standards meeting, the unit of work is the Internet-Draft, not the session — sessions are thin, drafts carry the substance.…

item.description: A standards meeting, so the unit of work is the Internet-Draft, not the session. item.author: ToFaRev
item.description: A working-group program, so this digest reads the drafts, not the talks: what is moving toward consensus, what changed in wire formats or security/identity mechanisms, and what is still an individual contribution. item.author: ToFaRev
